title: Dex
tagline: ꩜ Dex is a climate proof point of sale gadget for pseudo traceability
description: Inspired by the augmentation of a calculator, to morph the existing keypad interface into something that can more completely express transactions. All the way through the supply chain pseudo identifying peers in a point of sale / service like interaction using color and cultural signifiers. Let's give flex to off-chain reality quantization in monetary impact. For example, you might be able to assemble construction contract transaction that are baked into the wood of the building itself. Or, see all the trail of transaction by scanning a code on a coffee bag. With the use of such tool, one can become a local community wizard when supplying monetary resource leverage and supplies where needed.
how_its_made: This project uses a react frontend, with ethers js connected to sequence wallet. The interface captures tx transactions and after a peer connection to the fluence network, sends the transaction to another peer. The interface currently entails a way to view streams deployed by dex, and, stores assembled peer identies on textile's filecoin / polygon bridge. For the peer identities, a translation map was made from urbit identities to something new.
